reviews.text:
Leena is a nice vet and even though my own pet is always very nervous, everything always goes well.

The great thing is that when I went to the clinic due to an accident, Leena also took care of other pet-related issues, without a separate visit.

If you want bad service at a high price, this is your place!✨

When asked, they do not give exact information about what procedures are performed and what medications are prescribed, let alone their prices.

We vote with our feet and our pets' paws and move elsewhere. In addition, we clearly stated that we will not continue to visit here and the customer service representative tried to charge us for the next visit after this. So it pays to be vigilant!

The cat was vaccinated (at the same time a health check). For some reason, during this doctor's visit, my kitty got stressed and started hissing at the doctor.

The doctor then put a muzzle on the cat, which made my kitty really stressed. I felt kind of bad about this treatment and I was given the idea that I had a problematic cat.

After this, we changed the doctor's appointment to another place. It has been surprising to me how relaxed Lara has been with the new doctor. The problem is not with my kitty, but with the doctor and the way my kitty was treated.

I cannot recommend this place to anyone.

(Below is a picture of my kitty at the new doctor. It was so relaxed that the nurse couldn't even believe that the same cat had been muzzled)

Unhappy service. I'm not the only one to blame, but we dog owners are fed up with this because we are paying customers.
It's not enough for the staff to be polite, they also have to be knowledgeable, but when they're not. You've really lost a lot of customers.

We took our elderly cat here multiple times over two years near the end of his life. They informed us of all our options over several appointments, were respectful of our choices, and gave him (and us) extremely compassionate care from the beginning until the time came for him to be euthanized. We felt no pressure and appreciated the kindness. Very professional clinic.

Took my cat because she was lousy and not quite acting like herself. I mentioned that i had visited my mom not long ago and her cat had the cat flu. I think my cat has caught it now. Despite all of my describing they couldn't figure out what was happening and now she's coughing and clearly showing very flu like symptoms. Felt like they had no idea what they were doing.
